subject.title: fix(slack): use endsWith instead of includes for _all_ action_id matching

question: What is the permanent Slack contract for identifying disposable bulk-action rows: an explicit producer-owned block marker, an exact shared set/parser of action IDs, or a documented suffix convention?
rationale: Current source does not define or produce the claimed `_all` suffix grammar, while the shipped consumer already affects externally supplied Slack controls; choosing the permanent identifier boundary requires owner intent rather than another inferred string rule.

options.title: Use an explicit block marker
options.body: Have the producer assign a reserved bulk-row `block_id` or typed marker and make cleanup consume that exact contract, retaining compatibility only for proven shipped IDs.

options.title: Use exact shared action IDs
options.body: Define the complete producer-owned bulk action-ID set or parser in one shared module and reject arbitrary IDs that merely contain or end with `all`.

options.title: Adopt a suffix convention
options.body: Document `_all` as reserved, prove all existing producers and upgrades follow it, and accept the compatibility cost for custom controls ending with that suffix.

recommendation.title: Use an explicit block marker
recommendation.body: Have the producer assign a reserved bulk-row `block_id` or typed marker and make cleanup consume that exact contract, retaining compatibility only for proven shipped IDs.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows this person introduced the cleanup behavior and is the strongest current owner signal for the Slack interaction path.
